import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Constants
ARRAY_SIZE = 10000

def task_func():
    """
    Generate random integers, compute statistics, and draw a histogram.

    Returns:
        tuple: (array, mean, standard_deviation, ax)
    """
    # Generate random integers in the inclusive range [1, 100]
    arr = np.random.randint(1, 101, size=ARRAY_SIZE)

    # Compute statistics
    mean_val = float(np.mean(arr))
    std_val = float(np.std(arr))

    # Create histogram
    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    ax.hist(arr, bins=20, edgecolor="black")

    # Plot mean and standard deviation lines
    ax.axvline(mean_val, color="red", linestyle="--", linewidth=2, label="Mean")
    ax.axvline(mean_val - std_val, color="purple", linestyle="--", linewidth=2, label="Std Dev")
    ax.axvline(mean_val + std_val, color="purple", linestyle="--", linewidth=2)

    # Labels and title
    ax.set_title("Histogram of Random Values")
    ax.set_xlabel("Val")
    ax.set_ylabel("Freq")
    ax.legend()

    return arr, mean_val, std_val, ax
